items.question: Which contrasting states and qualities are affirmed together as real within this enumeration?
premises: Bondage and liberation are listed as paired conditions.
Happiness, enjoyment, and non-yoga are included among the enumerated states.
Truth, the atomic, and the great are presented alongside these conditions.
items.inference: Opposing experiential and ontological conditions are affirmed together as real.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of this list within the surrounding passage is not supplied by the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Bondage, liberation, happiness, enjoyment, non-yoga, truth, the atomic, and the great.
